stories.fullText: Government bond yields globally rose to multi-decade highs recently due to sell-offs in sovereign debt. Investors demanded higher returns amid persistent inflation and uncertainty regarding interest rates. India's benchmark 10-year bond yield peaked at 7.50% before slightly declining to 7.24%. Recent easing geopolitical tensions and declining crude prices have supported bond market recovery. Nonetheless, the outlook remains uncertain due to inflationary pressures and concerns over fiscal sustainability.
